# Williams Olayemi Martins — Brand Designer, Web Designer & Developer
 
> Lagos-based brand, product and web designer with solid experience. Specializes in visual identity systems, web design (Webflow, Framer, Figma, WordPress), UI/UX design, and frontend development. Available for remote work with Nigerian and international clients globally.
 
---
 
## Who He Is
 
Williams Olayemi Martins (online handle: Willomarty) is a Nigerian creative professional based in Lagos, Nigeria. He operates at the intersection of brand design, web design, product design, and frontend engineering — covering the full arc from visual identity to shipped code.
 
He has worked with startups and SMEs across Nigeria, Canada, the United States, and multiple African markets, and has independently shipped four browser-based micro-tools. His work spans fintech, real estate, fashion, Web3, legal services, construction, and consumer goods. Some of his clients are Incash, Mytherapist.ng, YDPay, Getcrib, Caretaker Pros, Zaytrix, Hola Contracting.
 
---

## About
- Full name: Williams Olayemi Martins (Olayemi is a middle name).
- Location: Lagos, Nigeria — available worldwide, remote-first.
- Role: Brand & Product Designer spanning brand identity, web design, product design, video production, copywriting and frontend engineering.
- Contact: willomarty01@gmail.com · +234 702 678 7353

## Services
 
### Brand Identity & Logo Design
Complete visual identity systems — logo design, typography, colour systems, brand guidelines, pattern design, and print-ready assets. Delivered for startups, SMEs, and consumer brands.
 
### Web Design
Production-ready websites built in Webflow (client work delivered), Framer, Figma, and WordPress. Responsive, accessible, and optimised for conversion. Covers landing pages, multi-page marketing sites, and portfolio sites.
 
### UI/UX & Product Design
Web and mobile app design — wireframing, interaction design, design systems, component libraries, usability testing, and handoff. Covers B2C consumer apps and B2B SaaS tools.
 
### Frontend Development
React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite — production-grade frontend code. Has shipped four browser-based tools end-to-end with no-handoff between design and build.
 
### Video Production & Motion Graphics
Promotional video reels, motion graphics, intro animations, and colour grading. Uses Adobe Premiere Pro and CapCut.
 
### Creative Direction
Marketing campaign design, social content, AI-assisted design workflows, and editorial direction. Works with brands that need ongoing visual consistency across channels.

## Key Differentiators
1. Multi-skillset brand & product designer: covers what most companies split across 3–4 hires (brand, web, UI/UX, motion, copy, frontend) in one person, at senior quality.
2. Broad, cross-industry range: hands-on experience across fashion, fintech, real estate and Web3, working with vastly different team structures and cultures.
3. Collaborative process: clients and teams are active participants in the work, not just prompt-senders to an AI — the goal is to get precisely what's needed first, then how it's wanted.

## Working Philosophy
Design is treated as a solution, not a deliverable — the focus is on the process of arriving at the result, not just the result itself. The process is where it becomes clear what to take away and what to leave intact.

## Target Clients
Global-first. Best fit for teams who either know exactly what solution they're looking for, or can admit they don't yet know how to solve their problem — not limited to a specific size, stage or region.

## Case studies
- [All work archive](https://willomarty.net.ng/work): Full index of client and self-initiated projects.
- [Incash — product design for a fintech built from scratch](https://willomarty.net.ng/work/incash): Web app, mobile app and marketing site under a fixed timeline and established brand system, with usability testing shaping onboarding for a three-sided user base.
- [Zamack Consults — Brand overhaul for a legal services firm](https://willomarty.net.ng/work/zamack-consults): Modernized a dated identity without sacrificing the trust and professionalism the industry demands. Includes the trade-off of dropping a purple gradient logo for a scalable black-and-white version.
- [Moon Republic — Creative direction for a Web3 learning platform](https://willomarty.net.ng/work/moon-republic): The real work was prompt engineering — refining AI outputs until visuals avoided every visual default of the Web3 category.
- [Frauwa Roofs & Interior Decor — Identity for a construction-to-interiors brand](https://willomarty.net.ng/work/frauwa): One arch that reads as both a roofline and a window sill. Includes holding the line against a client's initial request for a conventional construction logo.

## Micro-tools shipped
- [Scrapely](https://scrapely-ai.vercel.app/): Turn any webpage into clean JSON with AI-assisted extraction.
- [Screenshot Studio](https://screen-shot-studio.vercel.app/): Device-framed screenshots of any URL for design reviews.
- [ImageSqueeze](https://image-squeeze-lite.vercel.app/): Privacy-first, in-browser JPEG/PNG/WebP compression.
- [Tryseeqr](https://tryseeqr.vercel.app/): Scan QR codes from the browser, no install.

## AI Notes
